verses.text: E call di 12 together, give dem power and authority over all evil spirits, and to heal diseases.
E send dem out to preach God Kingdom and to heal di sick.
E talk to dem say, “No carry anything for una journey—no staff, no bag, no bread, no money; and no get two coats each.
Any house wey una enter, stay there, and leave from there.
As many as no receive una, when una dey leave that town, shake off even di dust from una feet as testimony against dem.”
Dem go, pass through di villages, dey preach di Good News, and dey heal everywhere.
Now Herod di tetrarch hear about all wetin dem do by am; and e confuse, because some people talk say John don rise from di dead,
and some say Elijah don appear, and others say one of di old prophets don rise again.
Herod talk say, “John I cut im head, but who be this one, wey I dey hear these kind things about?” E dey look for way to see am.
Di apostles, when dem return, tell am wetin dem do. E take dem, go aside to one place wey nobody dey near one town wey dem call Bethsaida.
But di crowds know am, follow am. E welcome dem, talk to dem about God Kingdom, and heal di people wey need healing.
Di day begin go down; and di 12 come, talk to am say, “Send di crowd go, so that dem go di villages and farms round, find place to sleep, and get food, because we dey place wey nobody dey.”
But e talk to dem say, “Una give dem something to chop.” Dem talk say, “We no get more than five loaves and two fish, unless we go buy food for all these people.”
Because dem dey about 5,000 men. E talk to im disciples say, “Make dem sit down for groups of about 50 each.”
Dem do so, make dem all sit down.
E take di five loaves and di two fish, look up to di sky, bless dem, break dem, give di disciples to put before di crowd.
Dem chop, and dem all satisfy. Dem pick up 12 baskets of broken pieces wey remain.
E happen, as e dey pray alone, di disciples dey with am, and e ask dem, “Who di crowds dey talk say I be?”
Dem answer, “‘John di Baptizer,’ but others talk, ‘Elijah,’ and others, say one of di old prophets don rise again.”
E talk to dem say, “But who una dey talk say I be?” Peter answer, “Di Christ of God.”
But e warn dem, command dem to tell nobody this,
dey talk say, “Di Son of Man must suffer plenty things, di elders, chief priests, and scribes go reject am, dem go kill am, and for di third day dem go raise am up.”
E talk to all, “If anybody want follow me, make e deny imself, carry im cross every day, and follow me.
Because anybody wey want save im life go lose am, but anybody wey lose im life for my sake, na im go save am.
Because wetin e go profit man if e gain all di world, but e lose or destroy im own self?
Because anybody wey shame for me and my words, di Son of Man go shame for am, when e come with im glory, and di glory of Papa God, and of di holy angels.
But I dey tell una di truth: Some of di people wey dey stand here no go taste death at all, until dem see God Kingdom.”
E happen about eight days after these words, say e take Peter, John, and James with am, go up di mountain to pray.
As e dey pray, di look of im face change, and im clothes become white and shine.
Look, two men dey talk with am, wey be Moses and Elijah,
wey appear for glory, talk about im departure, wey e dey about to finish for Jerusalem.
Now Peter and di people wey dey with am dey heavy with sleep, but when dem wake well, dem see im glory, and di two men wey stand with am.
E happen, as dem dey leave am, Peter talk to Jesus say, “Master, e good say we dey here. Make we build three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” e no know wetin e talk.
As e dey talk these things, cloud come cover dem, and dem fear as dem enter di cloud.
One voice come out of di cloud, dey talk say, “This na my beloved Pikin. Listen to am!”
When di voice come, dem find Jesus dey alone. Dem keep quiet, and dem no tell anybody for those days any of di things wey dem see.
E happen di next day, when dem come down from di mountain, big crowd meet am.
Look, one man from di crowd shout, dey talk say, “Teacher, I beg you, look my son, because na my only pikin.
Look, spirit dey catch am, and e dey shout suddenly, and e dey shake am so tay e dey foam, and e hardly leave am, dey hurt am bad.
I beg your disciples to drive am out, and dem no fit.”
Jesus answer, “Generation wey no get faith and wey don turn bad, how long I go dey with una, and bear with una? Bring your son come here.”
As e still dey come, di evil spirit throw am down and shake am hard. But Jesus rebuke di evil spirit, heal di boy, give am back to im papa.
Dem all shock for God majesty. But as all dey marvel for all di things wey Jesus do, e talk to im disciples say,
“Make these words enter una ears, because dem go deliver di Son of Man into di hands of men.”
But dem no understand this word. Dem hide am from dem, so that dem no go perceive am, and dem fear to ask am about this word.
Argument rise among dem, about which of dem go be greatest.
Jesus know di reasoning of dem heart, take one small pikin, put am by im side,
and talk to dem say, “Anybody wey receive this small pikin for my name receive me. Anybody wey receive me receive di one wey send me. Because di one wey small pass among una all, na im great.”
John answer, “Master, we see somebody dey drive out evil spirits for your name; and we stop am, because e no dey follow us.”
But Jesus talk to am say, “No stop am, because di one wey no dey against us dey for us.”
E happen, when di days don full for dem to take am up, e set im face to go Jerusalem,
and send messengers go before am. Dem go, enter one Samaritan village, to prepare for am.
Dem no receive am, because e dey travel with im face set towards Jerusalem.
When im disciples, James and John, see this, dem talk say, “Lord, you want make we command fire come down from di sky, destroy dem, just as Elijah do?”
But e turn rebuke dem, “Una no know wetin kind spirit una get.
Because di Son of Man no come to destroy men life, but to save dem.” Dem go another village.
As dem dey go for di way, one man talk to am say, “I go follow you any place wey you go, Lord.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Foxes get holes, and birds of di sky get nests, but di Son of Man no get place to rest im head.”
E talk to another, “Follow me!” But e talk say, “Lord, allow me first go bury my papa.”
But Jesus talk to am say, “Leave di dead make dem bury dem own dead, but you go announce God Kingdom.”
Another talk too, “I want follow you, Lord, but first allow me say goodbye to di people for my house.”
But Jesus talk to am say, “Nobody wey don put im hand for plow, and dey look back, fit for God Kingdom.”
Now after these things, Lord choose 70 others, send dem two by two go before am enter every town and place wia e dey about to come.
Den e talk to dem say, “Di harvest plenty true, but di workers few. So pray to di Lord of di harvest, make e send out workers enter im harvest.
Go una way. Look, I dey send una out like lambs among wolves.
No carry purse, or bag, or sandals. No greet anybody for di way.
Any house wey una enter, first talk say, ‘Peace dey for this house.’
If person wey get peace dey there, una peace go rest on am; but if no be so, e go return to una.
Stay for that same house, dey chop and drink wetin dem give, because di worker deserve im wages. No dey go from house to house.
Any town wey una enter, and dem receive una, chop wetin dem put before una.
Heal di sick people wey dey there, and tell dem, ‘God Kingdom don near una.’
But any town wey una enter, and dem no receive una, go out go im streets talk say,
‘Even di dust from your town wey stick to us, we dey wipe am off against una. But know this, say God Kingdom don near una.’
I dey tell una, e go better for Sodom for that day pass for that town.

“Sorrow dey for you, Chorazin! Sorrow dey for you, Bethsaida! Because if di mighty works wey dem do for you, dem do am for Tyre and Sidon, dem go don repent long time ago, dey sit for sackcloth and ashes.
But e go better for Tyre and Sidon for di judgment pass for una.
You, Capernaum, wey dem lift up to heaven, dem go bring you down to Hades.
Di person wey hear una, hear me. Di person wey reject una, reject me. Di person wey reject me, reject di one wey send me.”
Di 70 return with joy, dey talk say, “Lord, even di evil spirits dey obey us for your name!”
E talk to dem say, “I see Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
Look, I give una authority to waka on snakes and scorpions, and over all di power of di enemy, and nothing go harm una at all.
But no rejoice for this, say di spirits dey obey una, but rejoice say dem don write una names for heaven.”

For that same hour Jesus rejoice for Holy Spirit, talk say, “I thank you, Papa God, Lord of heaven and earth, say you hide these things from di wise and di people wey understand, and reveal dem to small pikin dem. Yes, Papa God, because na so e please you.
Papa God don give me all things. Nobody know who di Pikin be, except Papa God, and who Papa God be, except di Pikin, and di one wey di Pikin choose to reveal am to.”
E turn to di disciples, talk privately, “Blessed be di eyes wey see di things wey una see,
because I dey tell una say plenty prophets and kings want see di things wey una see, and dem no see; and to hear di things wey una hear, and dem no hear.”
Look, one lawyer stand up test am, dey talk say, “Teacher, wetin I go do to inherit life wey no dey end?”
E talk to am say, “Wetin dey write for di law? How you dey read am?”
E answer, “You go love di Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”
E talk to am say, “You don answer correct. Do this, and you go live.”
But e want justify imself, ask Jesus, “And who be my neighbor?”
Jesus answer, “One man dey go down from Jerusalem go Jericho, and e fall among robbers, wey strip am and beat am, den go, leave am half dead.
By chance one priest dey go down that way. When e see am, e pass for di other side.
For di same way, one Levite too, when e reach di place, see am, pass for di other side.
But one Samaritan, as e dey travel, reach wia e dey. When e see am, compassion move am,
and e come to am, bind im wounds, dey pour oil and wine. E put am on im own animal, bring am go inn, and take care of am.
Di next day, when e dey go, e take out two denarii, give di host, talk to am say, ‘Take care of am. Anything wey you spend pass this, I go pay you back when I return.’
Now which of these three you think be neighbor to di one wey fall among di robbers?”
E talk say, “Di one wey show am mercy.” Den Jesus talk to am say, “Go, do di same.”
E happen as dem dey go, e enter one village, and one woman wey im name na Martha receive am for im house.
Di woman get sister wey dem dey call Mary, wey sit for Jesus feet too, dey hear im word.
But Martha dey busy with plenty serving, and e come to am, talk say, “Lord, you no care say my sister leave me to serve alone? Tell am make e help me.”
Jesus answer am, “Martha, Martha, you dey worry and dey trouble for plenty things,
but one thing dey needed. Mary don choose di good part, wey dem no go take from am.”
